scope.purpose: Developer-authorized typography capability tests; no production acceptance

hypothesis: Measured line-layout alternatives and an optional frame-driven glyph sweep can address rigid line breaks and missing looping effects, but do not establish source font/artwork fidelity.

method.trigger: Observed undersized text, unnatural existing line breaks, or an actual source title/CTA light sweep
actions: Bind the actual font and original text region, then use bin/propose_typography.py to compare bounded one-to-three-line alternatives without changing final copy.
Select display.layout_lines using source composition and target-language reading. Preserve words and logical order; do not make single-line Arabic a default requirement.
When the source warrants it, specify display.motion.sweep period, width, color, opacity, direction and phase. The renderer clips light into whole glyph runs and maintains instance phase across shots.
Inspect actual title/CTA frames across a whole cycle and the resulting clean background. Reuse the existing artwork/style-layer route when a system font loses source weight, texture or depth.
failure_signatures: Only logo/background regions were compared, so the text effect itself was never verified.
A browser failure silently reduced the requested motion to a static layer; fallback evidence must identify the effects actually lost.
A technically fitting one-line title is thinner and flatter than the prior artwork; layout success is not overall visual improvement.

technical_regression.boundary: Contract/synthetic-media tests do not certify business quality.

de_observation.observation: Actual sampled output shows larger German CTA and moving repeating glyph light. Source heavy outline, drop shadow and hatched fill are not reproduced.

ar_observation.observation: Actual sampled browser output supports a complete joined RTL line, but the ordinary font loses the previous artwork's bold gradient and depth. Existing reconstructed finger/background discontinuities remain.

limitations: The two outputs are isolated developer demonstrations with prior audio reused; no new dubbing or model generation was tested.
Normal-speed playback, head/tail listening, independent review and user acceptance are pending. No whole-video quality pass is recorded.
This host lacks Pillow RAQM. Basic width measurements are labeled shaping_review_required for complex scripts; inspect actual browser glyphs before deciding layout.
Sweep period and font were selected adaptations, not automatically recovered source animation parameters.
Raw videos and detailed local receipts are not permanent dependencies of this technical candidate. The observations are bounded reports, not a reusable approved production master.
promotion: Not active retrieval knowledge. Review scoped evidence before adoption; do not infer a mandatory layout or effect from these tests.
